facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at PSV-4210 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 28 February 2026 an incident occurred on PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
